title: Influencer Marketplace Guide: TikTok, Instagram and How to Pick the Best One
summary: Compare influencer marketplaces across TikTok Shop, Instagram and YouTube. See fee models, creator rates, outreach and measurement so you can pick the best fit.
body_markdown:
## The Full Workflow: Find, Recruit, Sample, Contract, Pay, Measure


A complete creator workflow links discovery to sales measurement and sets clear terms at each handoff. For TikTok Shop, assess whether a marketplace helps identify creators, present offers, manage samples and agreements, track commissions, and evaluate performance. Reacher supports this process with AI Creator Search, outreach, creator CRM, Campaign Contracts, and reporting in one system.


### How Matching Works: Filters, AI Description Search, Lookalike and Transcript Search


Start with your product, intended customer, content style, and campaign goal. Filters narrow candidates by available profile criteria;[AI Creator Search](https://www.reacherapp.com/features/creator-discovery) lets you describe the creator you want in plain English. Its four modes are profile, transcript, visual, and lookalike search. Search by description, spoken content, product image, or similar creator, then review ranked matches for fit rather than relying on follower count alone.


Reacher’s database contains more than 4 million TikTok Shop creators. Treat results as a starting point: check recent content, product relevance, audience context, and selling approach before inviting creators. Relevant matches help reduce irrelevant outreach and give creators a clear reason to consider your offer.


### Outreach at Scale: DM, Target Collab and Email Without Burning Creator Goodwill


Make outreach targeted and transparent. Explain why the creator fits, what the product does, the compensation or commission, and the requested action. Reacher can send through DM, Target Collab, and email at up to 10,000 creators a day. Personalized Outreach drafts a unique message using creator and offer details, with tone control and a preview of the exact message before it sends.


Review drafts, remove unsupported claims, state the offer, and make it easy to respond. Track replies and follow-ups in the[creator CRM](https://www.reacherapp.com/features/creator-crm) to avoid repeated contact that undermines trust.


### Sample Fulfillment, Campaign Contracts and Usage Rights


Set weekly sample limits, confirm product availability, and monitor requests against fulfillment capacity. Reacher provides a shared queue, bulk rejection, and weekly sample caps. Track shipment and creator status together so delayed fulfillment does not leave creators waiting without updates.


Before production, document deliverables, deadlines, compensation, and usage rights. Reacher Campaign Contracts sends DocuSign agreements inside Community Campaigns using its standard template in V1. Check that the agreement matches campaign terms. Permission to publish a video on a creator’s account does not automatically grant permission for other placements, including paid ads.


### Creator Rates and Commission Benchmarks by Tier


No universal rate by follower tier applies to every campaign. Pricing varies with deliverables, production effort, audience fit, usage rights, exclusivity, and the creator’s terms. Use this framework to structure negotiations, then confirm the actual rate and commission with each creator.


Compensation element What determines it Buyer action


Flat creator fee Content format, production scope, and requested deliverables Specify quantity, format, and deadlines


Affiliate commission Commission terms and eligible sales State the rate and attribution rules before recruitment


Usage-rights payment Where and how long the content may be used Define placements and term in writing


### Payout Rails and Measurement: Connecting Marketplace Activity to Amazon, Shopify and Retail Sales


Set payout timing, commission calculations, returns treatment, and content fees before launch. Reacher Wallet pays usage-rights offers where supported. Its[Meta Ads](https://www.reacherapp.com/features/meta-ads) integration can run usage-rights creator videos as Facebook and Instagram ads with per-creator attribution and commissions paid through Stripe. Confirm applicable terms and supported payment arrangements.


TikTok Shop GMV reflects activity attributed within that channel.[Halo Effect](https://www.reacherapp.com/features/halo-effect) connects TikTok content to Amazon, Shopify, and retail sales to calculate cross-channel ROAS. Match the view to your measurement question and distinguish observed attribution from proven incrementality: cross-channel reporting connects activity and sales signals but does not establish that creator content caused every purchase.
